releaseNote.zh-cn:
1. 新增 支持全屏查看专辑封面
  2. 修复 部分设备上对播放队列重新排序可能失败或导致崩溃
  3. 修复 特定情况下在媒体扫描期间切换标签页偶发崩溃
  4. 修复 解析多音乐标签时可能存在末尾空格残留
  5. 优化 卡片播放器同样添加可选的顶部渐变遮罩，以提升可读性
  6. 开发 更新依赖
releaseNote.en:
1. New: full-screen image viewer for album artwork
  2. Fix: reordering playing queue may fail or cause crashes on some devices
  3. Fix: occasional crashes when switching tabs during media scanning under some circumstances
  4. Fix: possibly trailing spaces remained in the parsed multiple music tags
  5. Improve: add an optional top gradient scrim to the Card player as well, to enhance legibility
  6. Development: update dependencies

releaseNote.zh-cn:
1. 提示 自 v2.0 起，签名已被更换，详见发布页注释！
  2. 修复 状态栏颜色动画的若干异常表现
  3. 修复 播放器主题色在回到前台后瞬间显示为默认颜色
  4. 修复 播放器顶部某些情况下在导航栏后显露（Android 15+）
  5. 改进 优化方形屏幕适配
  6. 改进 增加播放控件按钮大小
  7. 移除 专辑与艺术家详情页的共享元素转场动画
  8. 新增 针对 Android 11+ 的真正边到边沉浸（可选，实验性支持）
  9. 开发 更新 Kotlin 至 2.4.10, 更新依赖
releaseNote.en:
1. NOTE: Since v2.0, we have replaced our signing key, see GitHub Release Page for details.
  2. Fix: some weird behaviours of statusbar color animations
  3. Fix: player theme color flashing to default when resuming from background
  4. Fix: top of player conditionally peaking behind navigation bar on Android 15 and later
  5. Improve: optimize for square-shaped screens
  6. Improve: enlarger playback buttons
  7. Remove: shard elements transition animations for albums and artist details
  8. New: support the true edge-to-edge display for Android 11 and later (optional, experimental)
  9. Development: upgrade Kotlin to 2.4.10, update dependencies
